icash_sender_private.cohort(uuid,uuid):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_sender_private.cohort(p_account uuid, p_thread uuid)
 RETURNS text
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select (s.snapshot#>>'{raw,data,state}')||'/'||public.icash_owner_targeting_pool(s.account_id,s.id)
 from public.icash_text_threads t join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id
 join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=d.screening_id and s.account_id=d.account_id
 where t.id=p_thread and t.account_id=p_account and t.party='seller'
 and s.snapshot#>>'{raw,data,state}' ~ '^[A-Z]{2}$'
$function$
icash_text_receipt_private.sender_opener:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_text_receipt_private.sender_opener_available(p_sender text)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
declare delayed_epoch numeric; delayed_at timestamptz;
begin
 -- Match the original signed notice, accepted provider ID, account, sending
 -- number and actual dispatch. Both arrival orders work once the receipts meet.
 select (e.payload->>'timestamp')::numeric into delayed_epoch
 from public.icash_text_events e
 join public.icash_text_messages m on m.provider_id=e.payload#>>'{data,affected_id}' and m.direction='outgoing'
 join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=m.thread_id and t.account_id=m.account_id and t.sender=p_sender
 join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key='text:'||m.id and o.account_id=m.account_id
 where e.type='numbers.delayed' and e.payload->>'type'=e.type and e.payload->>'id'=e.id
 and e.payload#>>'{data,reason}'='number_temporary_unavailable'
 and e.payload#>>'{data,original_number}'=p_sender and jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'timestamp')='number'
 and (e.payload->>'timestamp')::numeric <= extract(epoch from now()+interval '5 seconds')
 and o.dispatched_at<=now()
 and extract(epoch from o.dispatched_at) <= (e.payload->>'timestamp')::numeric+5
 order by (e.payload->>'timestamp')::numeric desc limit 1;
 if not found then return true;end if;
 delayed_at:=to_timestamp(delayed_epoch::double precision);

 -- A terminal delivery for work actually dispatched after the delay restores
 -- full speed. A late confirmation for an older send cannot clear a newer delay.
 if exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_messages m
  join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=m.thread_id and t.account_id=m.account_id and t.sender=p_sender
  join public.icash_operation_spend o on o.operation_key='text:'||m.id and o.account_id=m.account_id
  where m.direction='outgoing' and m.state='delivered' and m.provider_id is not null
   and m.last_delivery_at between delayed_at and now()+interval '5 seconds'
   and o.dispatched_at between delayed_at and now() and o.dispatched_at<=m.last_delivery_at+interval '5 seconds') then return true;end if;
 if delayed_at>now()-interval '5 minutes' then return false;end if;

 -- The live queue takes the shared operating-budget row lock before this
 -- check and inserts the assignment in the same transaction.
 return not exists(select 1 from public.icash_seller_opener_assignments a
  join public.icash_text_threads t on t.id=a.thread_id and t.account_id=a.account_id and t.sender=p_sender
  where a.message_id is not null and a.created_at>=now()-interval '5 minutes');
end $function$
icash_sender_private.requested_introduct:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_sender_private.requested_introduction(t icash_text_threads)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select coalesce((t.party='seller' and t.seller_intake_id is not null and t.operational_contact_id is null
 and t.retired_at is null and not t.paused and not t.manual_only and t.ai_mode='auto'
 and t.permission_until>now() and nullif(t.permission_evidence,'') is not null
 and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions x where x.phone=t.recipient)
 and exists(select 1 from public.icash_seller_intakes i
  join public.icash_seller_matches sm on sm.lead_id=i.id and sm.account_id=t.account_id
  join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=sm.account_id and d.screening_id=sm.screening_id
  join public.icash_screening_jobs s on s.id=d.screening_id and s.account_id=d.account_id
  where i.id=t.seller_intake_id and i.phone=t.recipient and i.ai_consented and i.state='assigned'
   and s.snapshot->'sellerRequest'->>'id'=i.id::text
   and d.stage='draft' and coalesce(d.terms->>'practice','false')<>'true')),false)
$function$
icash_sender_private.reply_source(icash_:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_sender_private.reply_source(m icash_text_messages, t icash_text_threads)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 with candidates as (
  select w.source_id id from public.icash_seller_limited_text_replies w
   where w.message_id=m.id and w.account_id=t.account_id and w.thread_id=t.id
    and m.request_key=w.source_id and m.body=w.body
  union
  select w.source_id from public.icash_seller_text_replies w
   where w.message_id=m.id and w.account_id=t.account_id and w.thread_id=t.id
    and m.request_key=w.id and m.body=w.body
  union
  select o.owner_reply_id from public.icash_sms_seller_openings o
   where o.interest_message_id=m.id and o.account_id=t.account_id and o.thread_id=t.id
    and m.request_key=o.owner_reply_id
    and exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_messages sent where sent.id=o.owner_question_id
     and sent.account_id=t.account_id and sent.thread_id=t.id and sent.direction='outgoing'
     and sent.state in ('accepted','delivered') and sent.provider_id is not null)
 ), verified as (
  select distinct r.id from candidates c
  join public.icash_text_messages r on r.id=c.id and r.account_id=t.account_id and r.thread_id=t.id
  join public.icash_text_events e on e.id=r.event_id
  where m.account_id=t.account_id and m.thread_id=t.id and m.direction='outgoing' and t.party='seller'
   and r.direction='incoming' and r.state='received' and r.created_at between m.created_at-interval '30 days' and m.created_at
   and e.type in ('text.incoming.sms','text.incoming.mms') and e.payload->>'id'=e.id and e.payload->>'type'=e.type
   and case when jsonb_typeof(e.payload->'timestamp')='number' then (e.payload->>'timestamp')::numeric
    between extract(epoch from m.created_at-interval '30 days') and extract(epoch from m.created_at)+5 else false end
   and e.payload#>>'{data,from}'=t.recipient and e.payload#>>'{data,to}'=t.sender
   and e.payload#>>'{data,body}'=r.body and length(btrim(r.body))>0
   and coalesce((e.payload->'optOut')='true'::jsonb,false)=false
   and public.icash_seller_response_disposition(r.body) is null
   and r.body !~* '(auto(matic|mated)?[ -]?(reply|response|message)|out of (the )?office|message (blocking|undeliverable)|wrong (person|number))'
   and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_suppressions s where s.phone=t.recipient)
 ) select min(id::text)::uuid from verified having count(*)=1
$function$
icash_sender_private.transactional(icash:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_sender_private.transactional(m icash_text_messages, t icash_text_threads)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(select 1 from public.icash_contract_text_deliveries d where d.message_id=m.id and d.thread_id=t.id and d.account_id=t.account_id)
 or (icash_sender_private.requested_introduction(t) and m.account_id=t.account_id and m.thread_id=t.id and m.direction='outgoing' and m.request_key=t.id
   and exists(select 1 from public.icash_seller_opener_assignments a where a.account_id=t.account_id and a.thread_id=t.id and a.message_id=m.id and a.body=m.body)
   and exists(select 1 from public.icash_sms_seller_openings o where o.account_id=t.account_id and o.thread_id=t.id and o.owner_question_id=m.id))
 or exists(select 1 from public.icash_cancellation_notices n where n.sms_id=m.id and n.account_id=t.account_id and n.destination=t.recipient)
 or exists(select 1 from public.icash_meta_lead_messages link join public.icash_meta_leads l on l.lead_id=link.lead_id
   join public.icash_seller_intakes i on i.id=l.lead_id and i.phone=t.recipient
   join public.icash_deal_files d on d.id=t.deal_id and d.account_id=t.account_id and d.screening_id=l.screening_id
   where link.message_id=m.id and link.purpose in ('initial','address_link','reply') and l.account_id=t.account_id
    and l.consent_receipt is not null and l.submitted_at<=m.created_at and l.contact_until>=m.created_at)
 or icash_sender_private.reply_source(m,t) is not null
 or exists(select 1 from public.icash_text_ai_jobs j where j.outgoing_id=m.id and j.account_id=t.account_id and j.thread_id=t.id
    and icash_sender_private.replied(t.account_id,t.id,m.created_at-interval '30 days',m.created_at,j.message_id))
 or (m.customer_author_id is not null and icash_sender_private.replied(t.account_id,t.id,m.created_at-interval '7 days',m.created_at))
$function$
